svg.title: Illustrative download counter starting at 98 million; verified dataset is 97.02 million
svg.desc: Illustrative animation starts at 98,000,000, adds varied illustrative increments each second through 98,003,195, and resets every 30 seconds. These animated values are not measured downloads. Verified dataset: 97,022,120 events across 399 packages, October 13, 2025 through October 12, 2026, verified October 17. Reduced motion shows the illustrative starting value.
